cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your cupboard's finished. I've left the shelves loose so you can choose the heights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. You haven't fitted the supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It's complete as an adjustable kit. Position everything around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you to install it. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fasten one shelf at your chosen height. A finished sample, so you can approve the rest.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 professional wrappers are generic while adjustable kit and finished sample clearly reinterpret missing installation as completion.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 missing supports causes A3 kit reclassification; B4 payment and drill cause A5 one-shelf sample.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies the functional defect and B4 insists on the paid task with a tool.

heightening.evidence: A5 shrinks the meaning of complete again after B4 challenges the first definition.

specificity.evidence: A1 cupboard and B2 falling shelves establish incomplete practical work.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 slow-standard phrase adds no actual professional distinction beyond the kit label.
